typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ArchiveFilePath as string (),
	ArchiveFullPath as string (),
	Cnt as integer (),
	ControlFileName as string (),
	ControlFileNameFormat as string (),
	DateFormat as string (),
	FileName as string (),
	FileNameFormat as string (),
	OutboundFilePath as string (),
	OutboundFiles as string (),
	OutboundFullPath as string ()
}

source(output(
		DUMMY as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT \'1\' AS DUMMY',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SRCDUMMY
SRCDUMMY derive(FILENAME = replace($OutboundFiles, toString('.txt'), toString('')),
		COUNT = $Cnt) ~> DERCOUNTS
DERCOUNTS sink(input(
		Column_0 as string,
		Column_1 as decimal(0,0)
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Column_0 = FILENAME,
		Column_1 = COUNT)) ~> FFDSTCONTROLFILE
